author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
அகர முதல எழுத்தெல்லாம் ஆதி
பகவன் முதற்றே உலகு.
transliteration:
Agara mudhala ezhuththellām ādhi
Bhagavan mudhaṟṟē ulagu.
english_translation: As the letter 'A' is the beginning of all letters, the Divine is the beginning of all worlds.
good_morning_message: Every great journey begins with one step. Let this morning be your beginning.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
அறத்தான் வருவதே இன்பம் மற்றெல்லாம்
புறத்த புகழும் இல.
transliteration:
Araththān varuvathē inbam matṟellām
Puṟaththa pugazhum ila.
english_translation: True joy comes only from righteous living. All else lacks both inner happiness and lasting fame.
good_morning_message: Let virtue be your compass today. From it flows every true joy.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
அன்பும் அறனும் உடைத்தாயின் இல்வாழ்க்கை
பண்பும் பயனும் அது.
transliteration:
Anbum aṟanum uḍaiththāyin ilvāzhkkai
Paṇbum payanum athu.
english_translation: If love and virtue grace a household, that is both the beauty and the purpose of family life.
good_morning_message: Let love and goodness fill your home this morning — that is life's finest treasure.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
தீயவை தீய பயத்தலால் தீயவை
தீயினும் அஞ்சப் படும்.
transliteration:
Thīyavai thīya payaththalāl thīyavai
Thīyinum añjap paḍum.
english_translation: Evil deeds bring evil results; therefore evil is to be feared more than fire.
good_morning_message: Let your actions today be seeds of beauty — they will bloom in time.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text: உலகம் தழீஇய தொட்பு
transliteration: Ulagam thazhīiya thoṭpu
english_translation: Friendship that embraces the whole world is the mark of wisdom.
good_morning_message: Open your heart wide this morning. Let your warmth reach the world.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
உவப்பத் தலைக்கூடி உள்ளப் பிரிதல்
அனைத்தே புலவர் தொழில்.
transliteration:
Uvappat thalaikūḍi uḷḷap pirithal
Anaitthē pulavar thozhil.
english_translation: To meet with joy, to part with longing thoughts — such is the craft of the wise and the poet.
good_morning_message: Cherish every meeting this morning. The beauty lies in the fullness of each moment.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
எண்ணிய எண்ணியாங்கு எய்துவர் எண்ணியார்
திண்ணிய ராகப் பெறின்.
transliteration:
Eṇṇiya eṇṇiyāṅgu eyduvar eṇṇiyār
Thiṇṇiyar āgap peṟiṉ.
english_translation: Those who think with firmness and resolve will achieve whatever they set their minds to.
good_morning_message: Think clearly, act firmly. Whatever you envision this morning, you have the power to achieve.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
இருள்சேர் இருவினையும் சேரா இறைவன்
பொருள்சேர் புகழ்புரிந்தார் மாட்டு.
transliteration:
Iruḷsēr iruvinayum sērā iṟaivan
Poruḷsēr pugazhpurindhār māṭṭu.
english_translation: The twin darkness of sin shall not touch those who walk in the luminous glory of the Divine.
good_morning_message: Walk in light today. Shadow cannot touch a radiant heart.

author: Thiruvalluvar
original_text:
எல்லாவற்றுக்கும் கடன்பட்டவன் இல்லறம்
வல்லானிடம் வாழ்க.
transliteration:
Ellāvaṟṟukkum kaḍanpaṭṭavan illaṟam
Vallāniḍam vāzhga.
english_translation: Blessed is the home where the householder fulfills all duties — to family, to guests, to ancestors.
good_morning_message: Greet this day knowing your love and care make the world a better place.

author: Ovaiyar
original_text: அறம் செய விரும்பு
transliteration: Aṟam seya virumbu
english_translation: Desire to do what is right and virtuous.
good_morning_message: A simple truth to begin this morning: let your first desire be goodness.

author: Ovaiyar
original_text: அன்னையும் பிதாவும் முன்னறி தெய்வம்
transliteration: Annaiyum pithāvum munnaṟi theyvam
english_translation: Mother and father are the first gods you will ever know.
good_morning_message: Begin this day by honoring those who gave you life. Gratitude is the root of all virtue.

author: Ovaiyar
original_text:
கல்லாதவரை
கற்றவர் இகழாமை வேண்டும்
transliteration:
Kallādhavarrai
Kaṟṟavar igazhāmai vēṇḍum
english_translation: The learned must never look down upon those who have not learned.
good_morning_message: Let your knowledge be a lamp you share, not a shield you hide behind.

author: Ovaiyar
original_text:
கற்க கசடற கற்பவை கற்றபின்
நிற்க அதற்குத் தக
transliteration:
Kaṟka kasaḍaṟa kaṟpavai kaṟṟapin
Niṟka athaṟkuth thaga
english_translation: Learn thoroughly without flaws; then stand firm in accordance with what you have learned.
good_morning_message: Learn with your whole heart. Then live what you have learned.

author: Bharathiyar
original_text:
ஆடுவோமே பள்ளு பாடுவோமே
ஆனந்த சுதந்திரம் அடைந்துவிட்டோம் என்று
transliteration:
Āḍuvōmē paḷḷu pāḍuvōmē
Ānanda sudhandhiram aḍaindhu viṭṭōm enṟu
english_translation: We shall dance! We shall sing! For we have attained the bliss of freedom!
good_morning_message: Rise with the spirit of freedom! Let your heart dance into this beautiful morning.

author: Bharathiyar
original_text:
தனியொருவனுக்கு உணவிலை என்றால்
ஜகத்தினை அழித்திடுவோம்
transliteration:
Thaniyoruvanukku uṇavilai enṟāl
Jagatthinai azhiththiḍuvōm
english_translation: If even one person goes without food, we shall overturn this unjust world order.
good_morning_message: Carry compassion as your strength today. A just heart can move the world.

author: Bharathiyar
original_text:
வாழ்க நலமே வாழ்க நலமே
வையம் உய்ய வாழ்க நலமே
transliteration:
Vāzhga nalamē vāzhga nalamē
Vaiyam uyya vāzhga nalamē
english_translation: May goodness flourish! May goodness flourish! May the world be uplifted through goodness!
good_morning_message: Rise today as a force of goodness. The world is uplifted by each kind heart.

author: Bharathiyar
original_text:
புதுமைப் பெண்ணே,
பூமியில் நீ வாழ வேண்டும்!
transliteration:
Pudhumai peṇṇē
Pūmiyil nī vāzha vēṇḍum!
english_translation: New woman! You must live boldly upon this earth!
good_morning_message: Rise boldly. The world needs your presence, your voice, your light.

author: Bharathiyar
original_text:
சிந்துக்குத் தந்தை முன்னம் ஒரு
சிற்றெறும்பு ஆங்கே இருந்ததுவே
transliteration:
Sindhukku thanthai munnam oru
Siṟṟerumbu āṅgē irundhadhuvē
english_translation: Before the great river was born, a tiny ant once walked that very path. Even the mightiest things have humble beginnings.
good_morning_message: Great things begin small. Start where you are this morning — your path matters.

author: Kaniyan Poongunranar
original_text:
யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்
தீதும் நன்றும் பிறர்தர வாரா
transliteration:
Yādhum ūrē yāvarum kēḷir
Thīdhum nanṟum piṟar thara vārā
english_translation: Every place is our hometown. Every person is our kin. Good and ill are not given by others — they come from within.
good_morning_message: Walk into this morning knowing: every soul you meet is family, every place is home.

author: Sangam Poet
original_text: யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்
transliteration: Yādhum ūrē yāvarum kēḷir
english_translation: Every land is my homeland; every person is my kin.
good_morning_message: Carry the spirit of universal kinship into this morning.

author: Sangam Poet
original_text:
மல்லல் மூதூர் வேவிடும் என்பது
தொல்லோர் கூறிய பழமொழி அன்றே
transliteration:
Mallal mūdhūr vēviḍum enbadhu
Thollōr kūṟiya pazhamozhi anṟē
english_translation: Even a great ancient town may perish — so say the elders. Yet virtue and love endure.
good_morning_message: Let your goodness be the thing that lasts. Build something that time cannot take.

author: Jain Sages
original_text:
கல்வி கரையில கற்பவர் நாள்சில
மெல்ல நினைக்கின் பிணிபல
transliteration:
Kalvi karaiyila kaṟpavar nāḷsila
Mella ninaikkiṉ piṇipala
english_translation: Knowledge is boundless, but our days are few. Think deeply — and learn without delay.
good_morning_message: Time is precious, knowledge is infinite. Make this morning count — learn something beautiful.

author: Andal
original_text:
மார்கழித் திங்கள் மதிநிறைந்த நன்னாளால்
நீராட போதுவீர் போதுமினோ நேரிழையீர்
transliteration:
Mārgaḻi thiṅgaḷ madhi niṟaindha nannāḷāl
Nīrāḍa pōdhuvīr pōdhuminō nērizhaiyīr
english_translation: On this auspicious full-moon morning of Margazhi, come, adorned ones, let us rise and bathe in the sacred waters.
good_morning_message: Rise with joy and purpose this morning. Sacred things await those who greet the day fully.

author: Tirumular
original_text: அன்பே சிவம்
transliteration: Anbē Sivam
english_translation: Love itself is the Divine.
good_morning_message: You need not search far. The Divine lives in every act of genuine love.

author: Tirumular
original_text:
உடம்பார் அழியில் உயிரார் அழிவர்
திடம்பட மெய்ஞ்ஞானம் சேரவும் மாட்டார்
transliteration:
Uḍambār azhiyil uyirār azhivar
Tiḍampaḍa meyññānam sēravum māṭṭār
english_translation: If the body perishes, the soul too fades. Care for the body so that true wisdom may be attained.
good_morning_message: Your body is the vessel of your spirit. Tend to it with love this morning.

author: Nammalvar
original_text:
மனத்தினால் நினைக்கவும் வாயினால் சொல்லவும்
கனத்த தொல் புகழ் கண்ணனை
transliteration:
Manaththināl ninaikkavum vāyināl sollavum
Kanaththa tol pugazh Kaṇṇanai
english_translation: With heart's thought and words of mouth — praise the ancient, weighty glory of Krishna.
good_morning_message: Begin this morning with gratitude in your heart and beauty on your lips.

author: Nammalvar
original_text:
உளன் கண்டாய் நன்னெஞ்சே உத்தமன்
பாதம் உளன் கண்டாய்
transliteration:
Uḷan kaṇḍāy nannenjsē uttaman
pādham uḷan kaṇḍāy
english_translation: He is present, good heart — the Supreme One is present in His very feet, and His feet are within you.
good_morning_message: The sacred is not distant. It lives right here, in your own heart.

author: Ilango Adigal
original_text: ஊழ்வினை உருத்தவந்து ஊட்டும்
transliteration: Ūzhvinai uruththavandhu ūṭṭum
english_translation: The fruits of past deeds ripen and present themselves in time.
good_morning_message: Act with care today — your deeds are seeds, and time is the farmer.

author: Sattanar
original_text:
யாவரும் யாவரும் நல்லவரே
யாவரும் யாவரும் தீயரோ
transliteration:
Yāvarum yāvarum nallavorē
yāvarum yāvarum thīyarō
english_translation: Are all people good, or are all people bad? — The measure lies in their actions, not their birth.
good_morning_message: Judge no one by birth or background today. See the goodness that resides in every soul.

author: Tolkappiyar
original_text:
அகம் புறம் என இருவகைப்பட்ட
தொகைமொழி வழக்கின் பகுதி
transliteration:
Agam puṟam ena iruvakaippaṭṭa
Thogaimozhi vazhakkin pagudhi
english_translation: Inner life and outer life — both are part of the great human expression of poetry and truth.
good_morning_message: Honor both your inner and outer worlds today. A full life touches both.

author: Bharathiyar
original_text:
என்னைத் தாழ்த்தினர்; என் மனந்
தாழவில்லை; தாழவில்லை!
transliteration:
Ennaich thāzhthinnar; en manan
thāzhavill lai; thāzhavilla i!
english_translation: They tried to diminish me — but my spirit did not bow. It did not bow!
good_morning_message: No circumstance can diminish your spirit unless you allow it. Rise unbowed.
